title: Address the reward v2 review: termination term, discriminator rename and implemented kernel C
summary: Reward version 2 now charges 75 per terminated control: Table I has no termination term, and because PPO bootstraps zero after a termination, a policy earning negative reward would otherwise gain by falling; 75 exceeds 0.721 / (1 - 0.99), the discounted value of continuing at the worst recorded mean reward. The AMP discriminator moves to locomotion/amp_discriminator.py and its style-reward factories and training command to locomotion/paper_reward.py, clearing the name for the AMP feature contract. The audit's kernel C column and formula tests now come from task_v2's causal window (0.940 on the fixture, not 0.970), evaluation records the reward a checkpoint trained with, and the task definition points its review at PR #42. The recorded rollouts contain no terminations, so the offline scoreboard is unchanged.
next: Rebase onto main after PR #39 merges, take the AMP width from amp.feature_contract(), regenerate the manifest, then rebuild the paired run packs from the final commit.
reason: Version 1 stays the default and no native run has used version 2, so no measured result, roadmap marker or gate changes.
